# Benefit Builder LLC, full overview

## Company

Benefit Builder LLC is a Texas-based, family-run Section 125 cafeteria plan administrator founded in 2019. We serve employers and brokers across the United States with bundled, all-inclusive monthly pricing. Headquartered at 14132 FM 1097 Rd West, Suite #300, PMB #164, Willis, TX 77318. Reach us at admin@benefitbuilderllc.com or (972) 741-5663. Founder: Bill Dawson.

## What we do

We administer Section 125 cafeteria plans (Premium Only Plans / POP) for employers. The plan lets employees pay for qualifying benefits with pre-tax dollars, which reduces the employer's FICA payroll tax liability up to 7.65% of participating wages and raises employee take-home pay.

Our work covers the full administrative lifecycle:

- Pre-implementation FICA savings analysis. We model the employer's expected payroll tax savings and per-employee take-home pay impact before signing.
- Plan documents. We prepare and maintain the Section 125 plan document, adoption agreement, and salary reduction agreement so the plan is IRS-compliant.
- Non-discrimination testing (NDT). We run annual NDT to confirm the plan does not discriminate in favor of key employees or highly compensated employees.
- Payroll integration. We sync rosters and configure payroll deduction codes with common payroll providers.
- Compliance support. We maintain audit-ready records, handle plan amendments, and provide ongoing compliance check-ins.
- HSA and FSA administration. We administer Health Savings Accounts, Flexible Spending Accounts, and Dependent Care FSAs alongside the core Section 125 plan.
- Supplemental benefits enrollment. We help employers offer life, accident, critical illness, disability, and gap protection with plain-language enrollment communications.
- Broker partnership. We co-broker and accept broker referrals with clear commission economics and bundled compliance support.

## Why employers choose us

- All-inclusive monthly fee. No per-task charges. Compliance, NDT, plan documents, and payroll integration are included.
- Texas-based, family-run. You talk to people, not call queues.
- Bundled compliance. The plan document, adoption agreement, salary reduction agreement, annual NDT, and audit-ready records are all included.
- Plain-language employee communications. Higher participation through better understanding.
- Fast quotes. Most employers get a quote within one business day.

## Why brokers partner with us

- Co-broker or refer. Both models supported.
- Compliance handled. NDT, plan documents, and audit records are our problem, not yours.
- Clear commission economics. No surprise splits.
- Texas brokers welcome. National reach.

We work with small and mid-size employers across the United States, with concentration in Texas. Common industries include healthcare, manufacturing, professional services, hospitality, construction, and trades.
